title: Orthogonal Norm Growth in Two-Tower Retrieval: A Popularity Mechanism for Unified Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.09294v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Unified search and recommendation systems may update the same item vectors from both interaction streams. We study how repeated updates can increase an item vector's norm and affect retrieval under an unnormalized dot product. A cosine-only loss makes the output gradient perpendicular to the current item vector - tangent to its constant-norm sphere. Training changes encoder parameters, however, so the realized item-vector movement need not remain tangent. We derive sufficient conditions under which it does; every nonzero update then increases squared norm by its squared length. When the tasks share an item encoder, sequential updates from both can accumulate in the same norm, which raw-inner-product serving can expose for either task. This conditional result is not a theorem about joint SGD. Controlled ablations test these conditions. translated_title: 双塔检索中的正交范数增长：统一发现场景下的流行度机制
translated_abstract: 统一搜索与推荐系统可能会从两个交互流（搜索流与推荐流）更新同一份物品向量。我们研究重复更新如何增加物品向量的范数，并在未归一化点积的检索方式下产生影响。仅使用余弦损失时，输出梯度垂直于当前物品向量——即与其恒定范数的球面相切。然而训练会改变编码器参数，因此实际产生的物品向量位移不一定保持切向。我们推导出使位移保持切向的充分条件；在此条件下，每一次非零更新都会使平方范数增加其自身长度的平方。当两个任务共享物品编码器时，来自两个任务的顺序更新可以在同一个范数上不断累积，而使用原始内积进行在线服务时，任一任务都可能暴露于这种范数增长之下。需要强调的是，这一条件性结果并非关于联合SGD的定理。受控消融实验对这些条件进行了检验。在MovieLens 32M和Amazon Books数据集上，累积的切向位移伴随着频率-范数关联现象出现。
tldr: 该论文揭示了双塔检索中仅余弦损失在特定充分条件下会导致物品向量范数随重复更新而正交增长，当搜索与推荐任务共享物品编码器并以原始内积服务时，这种增长会累积形成一种内在的流行度偏差机制。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that cosine-only loss in two-tower retrieval can cause orthogonal norm growth of item vectors under sufficient conditions, which accumulates into an intrinsic popularity mechanism when search and recommendation tasks share an item encoder and serve via raw inner products.
